title: Vue Multi-Step Intake View
description: Generates a route-per-step intake wizard (Stepper + StepErrorSummary, a required read-only review step, and a confirmation page) into an existing vue-app project. Cross-step state is server-persisted -- each step PUTs/POSTs to /api/<resource>/:id and refetches on mount; there's no client-side draft caching.

project.description: The vue-app project to add the views to.
project.x-prompt: Which project should the intake view be added to?

name.description: Base name for the generated views, e.g. 'application' generates <Step>StepView.vue per step plus ApplicationReviewView.vue and ApplicationConfirmationView.vue.
name.x-prompt: What should the intake flow be called?

resource.description: API resource path segment. Each step fetches/saves /api/<resource>/:id; the review step's Submit posts /api/<resource>/:id/submit.

route.description: Base route, e.g. /applications. Steps become /applications/:id/<step-key>, plus /applications/:id/review and /applications/:id/confirmation. Start a new intake at /applications/new/<first-step-key>.

steps.description: JSON array of steps, in order -- e.g. '[{"key":"personal-info","label":"Personal information","fields":[{"key":"fullName","label":"Full name"},{"key":"born","label":"Date of birth","type":"date"}]}]'. Each item: { key, label, fields: [...] }. Each field: { key, label, type?: "text"|"textarea"|"number"|"date"|"select" (default "text"), options?: [{value,label}] (select only, required for it), required?: boolean (default true) }. A number field is submitted as a number and a date as YYYY-MM-DD built from local calendar parts, not UTC. A plain array is also accepted when this generator is invoked programmatically. Nx's CLI option coercion only supports comma-separated primitive lists for array-typed schema properties, not JSON -- a JSON string is the only CLI syntax that survives Nx's own arg parsing.

requiresAuth.description: Whether the generated routes require authentication.
